row.name: NeoGenomics Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 3 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=10 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.29 tightness=0.88 base_volume_vs_leg=0.5 base_volume_vs_avg=0.63
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 6.5% vs its 20-SMA, 15.5% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The base box shows at least four wide, overlapping bars spanning nearly 3 points (roughly 16% of price) with visible red bars of meaningful size — this is not the tight, quiet consolidation Bonde requires, and the tightness score of 0.88 confirms it is well outside A+ territory. More decisively, this is the third breakout of a move that is already 83% off its start 60 sessions ago, and prior breakouts in this name worked only 1 of 4 times. Volume on the burst day ranked only 45th of the last 60 sessions and came in at 65% of the 50-day average — there is no institutional urgency behind this bar.
claude.key_risk: A third breakout in a mature 83% move with a poor prior-breakout hit rate (1/4) means the odds of a follow-through burst are structurally low, and any broad market softness will find no buyers above the entry.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst bar's close (~18.41) or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest and price drifts back toward the base high (~19.76 ceiling gap is not a concern, but a weak open into the base is).

row.summary: NEO: +6.3% on 1.4× volume out of a base 14.7% deep. C 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
